body:
Parent: #22 (Evidence & Data Trust).

## Traceability and dependencies
Requirements: FR-01, FR-02, FR-06 (defined in parent epic breakdown).
Depends on: None; foundation ticket.

## Outcome
A consumer can distinguish an observed fact, a missing value, a conflicting value and a legacy/default value without guessing from Product scalar defaults.

## Scope and technical plan
- Establish minimal Spec Kit project principles in `.specify/memory/constitution.md` from existing compatibility, meaningful verification, bounded usage and MIT/self-hostable constraints; initialize only the required planning templates/integration, without overwriting user configuration.
- Produce `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/evidence.md` in the shared feature directory. Resolve the field coverage matrix and unknown/default representation before dependent implementation.
- Define versioned evidence, field observations and resolution records: evidence ID, source URL, UTC observed timestamp, extraction method, captured excerpt or structured pointer into retained source, product/variant field path, raw and normalized values, support state and reason.
- Cover all source-derived Product/Variant facts, including attributes and collection elements; distinguish derived identity/metadata. Define explicit unknown/missing, unsupported and conflicting states, and default values versus actual zero/false.
- Define optional model/rule score separately from validated confidence, with validation method/dataset/version when a validated value exists. No synthetic calibrated probabilities.
- Add backward-compatible model and serialization contracts in `_models.py` and public exports; legacy records have explicit unsupported provenance.

## Acceptance scenarios
- Given absent price/currency/stock, when normalized, then the trust view marks them unknown/unsupported; a literal source zero or false is observed and distinguishable.
- Given nested variants/attributes, when inspecting field paths, then each factual field has evidence references or an explicit unsupported reason.
- Given a model score without calibration evidence, when serialized, then validated confidence remains unavailable.
- Existing Product/Variant constructors and canonical identity behavior remain usable; schema checks reject malformed IDs/timestamps/states.

## Validation and task handoff
Contract fixtures for missing versus zero/false, nested paths, legacy payloads and score semantics; verify spec-to-task coverage. This ticket establishes interfaces consumed by all following tickets.

## Spec Kit workflow
Use one shared feature directory, `specs/002-evidence-data-trust/`. Specify user outcomes and Given/When/Then scenarios in `spec.md`; record architecture, compatibility and resolved questions in `plan.md`; maintain dependency-ordered, requirement-linked work in `tasks.md`. Update the relevant artifacts before implementation and verify spec/plan/tasks consistency before closing this ticket. These are required implementation deliverables, not artifacts already generated by an installed Spec Kit workflow.

## Boundaries and definition of done
Evidence-backed reporting only; no catalog mutations, MCP, webhooks, or other epic work. Preserve MIT licensing and self-hostability. Prefer deterministic, offline fixtures; no model launch or broad live crawl is required. Document public APIs and limitations, and run meaningful affected compatibility checks. Do not equate extraction quality, rule/model scores, and validated confidence.
title: [Epic 2] Specify field evidence, unknown states and trust contracts
